title: Social and Fiscal Impact from Introduction of Plus and Prime HDB Flats
what_it_is: Social and Fiscal Impact from Introduction of Plus and Prime HDB Flats

sections.label: Housing subsidies and BTO questions
sections.summary: Questions ask the Minister for National Development about fiscal impact and spending on housing subsidies and grants for Plus BTO projects, singles and resale flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development what is the anticipated fiscal impact arising from additional taxpayer subsidies extended to Prime and Plus HDB flats under the new HDB BTO flat classification system.

sentences.speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development given the recent policy shifts announced in Budget 2023 and the National Day Rally 2023, how much more does the Government expect to spend each year on housing subsidies and grants to support home ownership for (i) Plus BTO projects (ii) singles in any BTO location across Singapore and (iii) resale HDB flats, respectively.

sentences.speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) in light of the policy shift to allow singles to own two-room BTO flats in all locations, whether there will be more two-room flats offered in future Plus and Prime BTO projects; (b) if so, how will the Government ensure sufficient supply of bigger flats for couples and families in these projects; and (c) what are the Government's principles and parameters towards providing a fair chance for all Singaporeans to own Plus and Prime BTO flats.

sections.label: Standard Plus Prime BTO models
sections.summary: From the second half of 2024, BTO projects will be offered under Standard, Plus or Prime models based on locational attributes rather than mature or non-mature estates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: From the second half of 2024, Build-To-Order (BTO) projects will be offered under Standard, Plus or Prime models based on their locational attributes, rather than whether they are in mature estates or non-mature estates.

sections.label: Grants for Singaporean households
sections.summary: This states that the amount is $14,000 for families and covers eight in 10 Singaporean households.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Today, this is $14,000 for families and covers eight in 10 Singaporean households.

sections.label: Plus model flat price
sections.summary: Under the Plus model, tighter restrictions and additional market discounts bring the price down to around $550,000 before grants.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Under the Plus model, due to tighter restrictions and additional market discounts, the price comes down to around $550,000 before grants.

sections.label: Subsidy recovery on first resale
sections.summary: A subsidy recovery rate will be imposed for the first buyer upon first resale, commensurate with the additional market subsidies given.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In addition to the tighter restrictions, we will also impose a subsidy recovery rate for the first buyer upon first resale, which will be commensurate with the extent of the additional market subsidies given.

sections.label: HDB Home Ownership Programme deficit
sections.summary: In FY 2021/2022, HDB recorded a deficit of around $3.85 billion in its Home Ownership Programme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In FY 2021/2022, HDB recorded a deficit of around $3.85 billion in its Home Ownership Programme.

sections.label: 2-room Flexi flat launches
sections.summary: From 2024 to 2026, up to 14,000 2-room Flexi flats will be launched, about 30% more than from 2021 to 2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Over the next three years, from 2024 to 2026, we will launch up to 14,000 2-room Flexi flats, an increase of about 30% over the past three years from 2021 to 2023.

sections.label: Government housing policy changes
sections.summary: The changes reflect the Government's commitment to affordable home ownership, good social mix and fairness, with further details to be announced.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: These broad changes reflect the Government's commitment to ensure that home ownership remains affordable, maintains a good social mix in every town and region and keeps the system fair.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We will continue to engage Singaporeans on these changes and announce further details on the specific policy moves when we are ready.
